facts.fact: Burundi's Loi N°1/22 of 22 August 2024, the code of electronic and postal communications, was promulgated; the file's note reports that its article 1 applies to all transactions by electronic means including commerce by electronic means, and that Burundi has no free-standing e-commerce, electronic transactions or electronic signature law (the PDF itself is an image-only scan with no extractable text).
